metadata.keywords: Rick and Morty interdimensional mad science aesthetic
metadata.style: Rick and Morty cartoon illustration — wobbly clean outlines, flat color with shading, interdimensional mad science applied to industrial space hauling. The visual language of a genius alcoholic's garage workshop scaled up to interplanetary colonization. Every piece of technology looks simultaneously like junk and like the most advanced thing in any dimension.
metadata.quality: Adult Swim animation still, 2K widescreen frame
